## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**2. Which sectors are leading?**

Energy strong: PSX (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +16.66%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND. Communication showing strength: NFLX (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +16.82%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -10.76% | 1M: -1.45%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -4.61%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: DE (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -8.29%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft on 1W: JPM (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +3.48%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

Top 5: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +8.63% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +25.02%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +16.82%) ABOVE TREND. **5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -10.76% | 1M: -1.45%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -8.07% | 1M: -12.00%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -8.49% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in semis/tech and select materials names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +25.02%) ABOVE TREND; watch TSLA (1W: +7.21% | 1M: -7.34%) RECOVERY for a potential short-term trend change. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: several mega-cap techs show 1W/1M mismatch (MSFT, NVDA, AMZN) — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed, with clear short‑term weakness. NVDA (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.65% | 1M: +21.76%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: +4.82% | 1M: -3.25%) RECOVERY; sector return -2.16% (24 stocks) and overall sector positioning suggests selectivity.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Cautious / transitional: V (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +6.58%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +3.48%) CORRECTION; sector 1W -0.83% (20 stocks) — mixed internals, monitor earnings and rate flows.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Clear strength and leadership. JNJ (1W: +4.81% | 1M: +9.10%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.34% | 1M: +15.21%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W +4.00% (17 stocks) — accumulation confirmed.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Healthcare and Energy names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND performance (MRK, PFE, PSX) and reduce exposure to weak semis/tech names under pressure (AVGO, AMAT, CSCO). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; remain stock‑selective and avoid broad sector bets given NEUTRAL regime.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +25.02%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +16.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (Breadth driving leadership; 1W +4.00%). BEARISH: Technology and Industrials (1W -2.16% and -2.16%, respectively) — watch semiconductor earnings and industrial orders for confirmation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
MRK above-trend continuation if it holds recent gains (watch near last-week highs given rapid move). AVGO downside momentum to monitor for new lows after a steep 1W drop. NVDA watch previous support zones that, if broken, would confirm CORRECTION extension.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
RTX (+80): Tomahawk deal and raised guidance — DE/RTX headlines confirming industrial strength; RTX performance aligns with industrial bullishness (RTX is in Industrials). TGT (+75): raised sales guidance and retail uplift — TGT showing sector confirmation (Consumer Stpl. positive). GILD (+50): positive coverage and price ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.63% | 1M: +13.29%) — sentiment confirming accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
NUE (-60): headline on Berkshire stake reduction and share pressure matches 1W weakness (NUE 1W: -8.49% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirming distribution. WMT (-50): negative retail headline and WMT (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +3.54%) CORRECTION — watch for follow‑through. UNH (-45): IRS scrutiny with price BELOW TREND (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -10.94%) — sentiment and price aligned, downside risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +7.34% | 1M: +15.21%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND and AMAT (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND are key weakness. Key risk: tech/semiconductor divergence versus strong Healthcare sentiment — watch for trend breaks and news‑driven distribution.
